title.en: Phasor Diagram of Series LCR Circuit
title.hi: श्रेणी LCR परिपथ का फेजर आरेख
title.hinglish: Series LCR circuit ka phasor diagram

description.en: Phasor diagram showing voltages across Resistor ($V_R$), Inductor ($V_L$), and Capacitor ($V_C$). Here, $V_L > V_C$ is assumed.
description.hi: प्रतिरोधक ($V_R$), प्रेरक ($V_L$), और संधारित्र ($V_C$) के सिरों पर वोल्टेज को दर्शाने वाला फेजर आरेख। यहाँ, $V_L > V_C$ माना गया है।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Axes (Current I is on x-axis) -->
  <line x1="150" y1="150" x2="350" y2="150" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4" />
  <line x1="150" y1="250" x2="150" y2="50" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4" />

  <!-- Current I (Reference, along x-axis) -->
  <line x1="150" y1="150" x2="300" y2="150" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="3" />
  <polygon points="300,150 292,145 292,155" fill="#10b981" />

  <!-- V_R (in phase with I) -->
  <line x1="150" y1="150" x2="260" y2="150" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="4" />
  <polygon points="260,150 252,146 252,154" fill="#ef4444" />

  <!-- V_L (Leads I by 90) -->
  <line x1="150" y1="150" x2="150" y2="60" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="4" />
  <polygon points="150,60 146,68 154,68" fill="#ef4444" />

  <!-- V_C (Lags I by 90) -->
  <line x1="150" y1="150" x2="150" y2="220" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="4" />
  <polygon points="150,220 146,212 154,212" fill="#ef4444" />

  <!-- Resultant of V_L and V_C (V_L - V_C) -->
  <line x1="150" y1="150" x2="150" y2="95" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="4" />
  <polygon points="150,95 146,103 154,103" fill="#f59e0b" />

  <!-- Parallelogram completion for resultant V -->
  <line x1="150" y1="95" x2="260" y2="95" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4" />
  <line x1="260" y1="150" x2="260" y2="95" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4" />

  <!-- Resultant Voltage V -->
  <line x1="150" y1="150" x2="260" y2="95" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="4" />
  <polygon points="260,95 251,96 256,104" fill="#3b82f6" />

  <!-- Phase angle phi -->
  <path d="M190,150 Q188,140 185,133" fill="none" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="2" />

</svg>
